name: injury
description: Injuries — one wound per body part, three severities, named by the damage type that caused them. Wounds appear, penalise, heal on their own, and can be treated with field medicine or cleared outright by a clinic. Enemies are wounded too (in-memory, dies with the mob), and `aim` lets a player call their shots at an accuracy cost.
extensionPoints: severityOf(player, part) — sync, query-free severity read
bodyReport(player) — all seven parts with bands, for the Vitals paper doll
clearInjuries(player, opts) — the surgical tier; used by plugins/clinic
tags.treat_injury on any consumable — { steps, floor, types?, all?, chance? }
enemySeverity(enemy, part) — sync severity read on a live enemy instance
enemyWoundNote(enemy) — one clause for look/examine, or null
player._aimPart — read by combat.js to bias the body-part roll
TEACH_AIM (dialogue action, no params) — an NPC teaches `aim`, worded against the player's live weapon skill
enemy._injuryHitMod / _injuryFleeMod — read by combat.js; absent = unchanged
enemyHasCapability(enemy, name) — sync check; true while any part granting that capability is un-maimed
grants.capability 'grab' on a body part — the creature holds you in the room until that part is maimed (move gate 'injury:grab')
enemyCapabilityNote(enemy) — one clause for examine naming what it can do to you, or null
